verdict.rationale: Moss clearly provides semantic similarity search over embeddings. It supports a built-in embedding model or bring-your-own vectors via a `custom` model, with sub-10ms queries, a `minScore` threshold and a hybrid `alpha` blend. The evidence never mentions an approximate nearest-neighbor index or any option to choose a distance metric such as cosine, dot product or L2. Missing for 10: configurable distance metrics, explicit documentation of the ANN index type and its tuning, independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
